svg.text: Each LED is labelled byte.bit: byte n is digit register n of the module's MAX7219 and MatrixBuffer[8 * module + n], bit b is bit b of it.
A blue band joins the LEDs of one byte, the darker one is its bit 0. Matrix orientation 0. Drawn by docu/DocuPictures.cpp from setDot() and the MAX7219 model.
